name: telegram-history-export
description: Export your own Telegram message history with context into structured JSON, using Telegram's official takeout API through telethon. Handles a clean interactive login that guarantees a working session (the desktop tdata conversion route produces a broken session whose get_me returns None and mislabels every message), decides authorship by the union of the out flag and the sender id, and can exclude whole lurk-only folders (any folder whose title contains scrape) so read-only groups do not drown the messages you wrote. Chat history is private data and never enters the repo; only synthetic fixtures ship.
